description: The last LR-1 built; at 35.3918N 139.9167E in front of the aviation archive since 2019; repainted in 2024 and pulled out onto the apron for the 2024 and 2025 air festivals
The only VIP-configured JGSDF V-107; struck off in FY1996 and kept in a hangar until it went into the new PR room at the 25 Feb 2017 open day; marked IIH
